statement: For any compatible Context, the ordinary source and open tensor bifunctors restricted to pairs of good complexes have natural presentations by the localized source and open total complexes. Their isomorphism components are exactly sourceRepresentative and openRepresentative, with arbitrary proof of K-flatness of the restricted second input.

proof.text: Restriction preserves good complexes by the existing open-restriction-good-complex theorem. Extension preserves their K-flatness by strictOpen.kflat. Lift these functors to the K-flat full subcategories.

proof.text: The canonical integral tensor models are natural isomorphisms on pairs of K-flat complexes. Whisker their comparisons by the extension, restriction and good-to-K-flat inclusions. Compose with the actual extension and restriction derived-functor counits. This gives natural representative isomorphisms cs and cu whose components are exactly sourceRepresentative and openRepresentative.
